caption: The drawing shows a wooden desk with a rectangular shape and straight, tapered legs. The desk consists of two main sections: a lower table portion and an upper cabinet. The wood is rendered in light to medium brown tones with visible grain patterns. The upper cabinet is box-shaped and has two sliding door panels on the front, each panel outlined with a narrow border, and there is a small metal lock at the top center where the panels meet. The side of the upper cabinet also shows metal hinges. The lower desk section has a flat writing surface, and beneath it on the right side is a single round-handled drawer. The desk is set against a plain, cream-colored background without any additional objects or decorations.
title: Shaker Desk
